title: Monro Announces Strategic Alternatives Review to Maximize Shareholder Value
summary: Monro, Inc. (Nasdaq: MNRO), a leading provider of automotive repair and tire services, today announced that its Board of Directors (the “Board”) has initiated a review of strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value.
